text.tspan: Red envelopes are part of a Lunar New Year greeting.
There is more than one way to welcome the new year together. In my experience, practical preparation and attention to others are two
One reason is that asking about a custom prevents careless assumptions. For instance, we ask the host how their family exchanges
greetings. This prevents a small difficulty from taking over the experience. It also leaves us more time to notice what is happening.
Another reason is that sharing time connects generations. For example, we invite an older relative to explain a family recipe. This
approach recognises that the experience belongs to more than one person and that different people may need different things.
These examples show why preparation and consideration work well together. We do not have to control every detail. We can make a
sensible arrangement and remain ready to respond.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the conclusion. Each
body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the argument rather than introduce a
Identify two obstacles that could arise when people welcome the new year together. Explain a workable response to each, rather than
merely listing the problems. Use four short paragraphs: introduction, two developed points, and conclusion. (Model: One possible
outline: introduce the situation; discuss asking about a custom prevents careless assumptions with an example; discuss sharing time
connects generations with a different example; conclude by connecting the two points.)
